verdict.rationale: Auth0 explicitly advertises SCIM as a feature for synchronizing customer directories/users (auth0-docs-21, auth0-docs-90), which implies group/user provisioning parity with the IdP. However, the evidence pack lacks dedicated technical documentation walking through SCIM setup, group mapping, or explicit confirmation that IdP-side deprovisioning revokes app access, and there is no independent/hands-on corroboration of this workflow. Missing for 10: detailed SCIM configuration docs, explicit deprovisioning behavior confirmation, and third-party validation.
